label: Fluid dynamics

request.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Asset type: ONE original standalone category artwork for Ben Ebsworth's open-margin research folio, not a logo tile, not a contact sheet.
Style and medium: sophisticated tactile scientific-editorial engraving; precise graphite contours, dense but controlled dry-pencil hatching and fine stipple, warm ivory opaque subject surfaces, subtle material depth drawn by hand. Restrained muted vermilion red occupies a very small structural detail only. Quiet, authored and intellectual; strong distinctive silhouette.
Canvas and framing: square canvas, ideally 1024 by 1024 pixels. The drawing must be SMALL on the canvas: its complete silhouette, including every line, occupies at most the central 50 percent of BOTH the canvas width and height. Leave the outer 25 percent on ALL four sides completely transparent and empty. Do NOT zoom the object to fill the canvas; pull the camera well back. A single coherent isolated object/composition, generous negative space, slightly three-quarter view, no rectangular card or page surrounding it.
Background and edges: genuinely transparent alpha outside the artwork and through purposeful gaps. Solid subject surfaces must be opaque. Crisp natural antialiased edge; absolutely no white fringe, aura, outer glow, bloom, fog, cast shadow or vignette. Do not draw a checkerboard, paper rectangle, backdrop or horizon.
No words, letters, numbers, labels, pseudo-text, scales, arrows, annotations, watermarks, logos or signatures. No glossy sci-fi, plastic gradients or generic stock icon styling. The artwork is an invented visual metaphor, not a scientifically exact diagram, technical instruction, measurement or evidence.
Subject for this image: Fluid dynamics — vortex around streamlined body.
Composition: A streamlined teardrop-shaped graphite-and-ivory body suspended diagonally, with a small family of clearly separated engraved fluid ribbons wrapping around it and curling into one visible open vortex downstream. The body is distinct and substantial; the sweeping fluid ribbons form an elegant asymmetric silhouette with clear transparent spaces between them. One short ribbon segment is muted red. No foamy ocean, blue liquid fill, smoke, glow or arrows; this is a stylised flow metaphor, not computed streamlines.
